sketches.mechanism: Default argument expressions are evaluated once at function definition time, so a mutable default object is shared by every call.
sketches.resonance: What was meant to begin empty keeps the trace of every return.

sketches.mechanism: Function arguments are lazy promises; an unused argument is never evaluated, so even an undefined name causes no error.
sketches.resonance: What is never looked at is allowed to remain nonexistent.

sketches.mechanism: Nothing is the bottom type, a subtype of every type; a nonterminating expression can inhabit any expected type because it never produces a value.
sketches.resonance: The unreachable can promise any shape by never arriving.
